Method of Attack: Ransomware as a Service (RaaS) distributed through affiliates
Distribution via RIG Exploit Kit on hacked sites exploiting vulnerabilities
Creates mutex and file to prevent multiple executions
Communicates with Command & Control server over UDP transmitting victim info
Encrypts files with unique random extension per victim
Creates ransom notes with links to TOR payment site
Impacted Systems: Windows OS (implied by %AppData% path and Windows updates)
Attack Vector: Affiliate distribution via underground criminal forums
